data.name: Name
data.value: Code

data.name: Overview
data.value: Display code, configuration and API samples with syntax highlighting, a copy button and, for examples written in several languages, a language selector.

data.name: IndexDescription
data.value: Highlighted code blocks and multi-language examples with copy and language selection.

data.name: Purpose
data.value: Help developers read and reuse code examples. Applications supply the source text and languages; the component owns highlighting, copying, language selection, accessibility and styling.

data.name: WhenUse1
data.value: Show a code snippet, a configuration file or an API request or response.

data.name: WhenUse2
data.value: Show the same example in several programming languages.

data.name: WhenNot1
data.value: Short code inside a sentence. Use the code element instead.

data.name: WhenNot2
data.value: Secrets or real credentials. Use placeholders such as YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN.

data.name: Accessibility1
data.value: Give each code block a title, or place it under a heading that explains its purpose.

data.name: Accessibility2
data.value: The code area receives keyboard focus so long lines can be scrolled with the arrow keys.

data.name: Accessibility3
data.value: The language selector is a labelled native select, and copy results are announced in a polite status message.

data.name: Ux1
data.value: Keep examples short and focused. Link to complete files instead of pasting long sources.

data.name: Ux2
data.value: Use the same sync group for examples on one page that share languages, so readers choose their language once.

data.name: NoteLanguages
data.value: Highlighted languages: csharp, javascript, python, json, cshtml, markup (HTML), css, bash and aspnet. Other identifiers are displayed as plain text.

data.name: NoteEncoding
data.value: Code is always treated as text and encoded once; it is never run or inserted as HTML. Line endings are normalized to line feeds.

data.name: NoteProgressive
data.value: Without JavaScript, every language variant is displayed with its label and the copy and language controls are hidden. Printing also shows every variant.

data.name: NoteLimit
data.value: Highlighting starts when a block becomes visible. Code longer than 50,000 characters is displayed without highlighting.

data.name: NoteDynamic
data.value: After inserting components into the page with JavaScript, call FDCPCode.initialize(container). Initializing the same component again has no effect.

data.name: BlockTitle
data.value: Code block

data.name: BlockText
data.value: Use fdcp-code-block for one snippet. Pass the source in the code attribute, or write it as encoded child content: the first and last blank lines and the common indentation are removed.

data.name: ExampleTitle
data.value: Multi-language example

data.name: ExampleText
data.value: Use fdcp-code-example to show the same example in several languages. Both examples below share a sync group: changing the language in one changes the other. The second example also offers Bash; choosing it leaves the first example unchanged.

data.name: FallbackTitle
data.value: Plain text and wrapping

data.name: FallbackText
data.value: Unknown languages are displayed as plain text. Use wrap="true" for long lines that are easier to read wrapped, and copy-enabled="false" when copying is not useful.

data.name: RendererTitle
data.value: Rendering from C#

data.name: RendererText
data.value: Code that builds HTML in C# can call FDCPCodeRenderer.Render, which returns IHtmlContent with the same markup as the Tag Helpers. Tag Helpers placed inside generated HTML strings are not processed by Razor.

data.name: SampleResponseTitle
data.value: Example response

data.name: SampleRegistrationTitle
data.value: Register Foundation services

data.name: SampleCreateTitle
data.value: Create a request

data.name: SampleReadTitle
data.value: Read a request

data.name: SampleLogTitle
data.value: Application log

data.name: SampleRequestTitle
data.value: Access to information request

data.name: PropCode
data.value: Source text. When omitted, the encoded child content is used.

data.name: PropCopyEnabled
data.value: Displays the copy button.

data.name: PropId
data.value: Identifier of the component. Generated when omitted.

data.name: PropLanguage
data.value: Language identifier, such as csharp, javascript, python or json. Unknown languages are displayed as plain text.

data.name: PropLanguageLabel
data.value: Display name of the language. Derived from the language when omitted.

data.name: PropTitle
data.value: Visible title, also used to name the code area and the copy button.

data.name: PropWrap
data.value: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

data.name: PropExamples
data.value: Language variants (CodeSample: Language, Label, Code). Languages must be unique.

data.name: PropSelectedLanguage
data.value: Language displayed first. Defaults to the first example.

data.name: PropSyncGroup
data.value: Examples with the same group on a page switch language together.
